headline: SpaceX lenders object to launching chip collateral into orbit
summary: SpaceX's lenders and bondholders object to the company launching its chip collateral into space, wanting it kept on Earth and within reach instead.

claims.statement: SpaceX's lenders do not want their chip collateral launched into orbit.

sources.quote: Bondholders want SpaceX’s valuable chip collateral kept on Earth and within reach.
Lenders don't want SpaceX shooting their collateral into orbit.
